description: A try without a catch bridges nothing: a shape that does not catch does not read as if it does.

diagnostics.message: Call to `JSON.parse` escapes this `@nothrow` function: it is colored `throwing` by the shipped standard-library baseline, so calling it can throw. Your outs: bridge this call with `try`/`catch`; or, if it cannot throw, report it against the shipped standard-library baseline at https://github.com/MidnightDesign/no-throw/issues — the other three carriers are keyed by npm package name, and no key in that grammar reaches a `lib.*.d.ts` member.
